mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_enrollments ( id, course_id, user_id, applied_by, application_type, status, applied_at, approved_at, rejected_at, cancelled_at, withdrawn_at, rejection_reason, cancellation_reason, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{courseId}, #{userId}, #{appliedBy, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{applicationType}, #{status}, #{appliedAt}, #{approvedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{rejectedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{cancelledAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{withdrawnAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{rejectionReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cancellationReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, course_id, user_id, applied_by, application_type, status, applied_at, approved_at, rejected_at, cancelled_at, withdrawn_at, rejection_reason, cancellation_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_enrollments WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, course_id, user_id, applied_by, application_type, status, applied_at, approved_at, rejected_at, cancelled_at, withdrawn_at, rejection_reason, cancellation_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_enrollments WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, course_id, user_id, applied_by, application_type, status, applied_at, approved_at, rejected_at, cancelled_at, withdrawn_at, rejection_reason, cancellation_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_enrollments WHERE id IN
#{id, javaType=java.util.UUID, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ObjectTypeHandler}
SELECT DISTINCT c.institution_id::text FROM tb_enrollments e JOIN tb_courses c ON c.id = e.course_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.institution_id::text

SELECT id, course_id, user_id, applied_by, application_type, status, applied_at, approved_at, rejected_at, cancelled_at, withdrawn_at, rejection_reason, cancellation_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_enrollments WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('APPLIED', 'WAITLISTED', 'APPROVED')

SELECT id, course_id, user_id, applied_by, application_type, status, applied_at, approved_at, rejected_at, cancelled_at, withdrawn_at, rejection_reason, cancellation_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM tb_enrollments WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND status IN ('APPLIED', 'WAITLISTED', 'APPROVED') ORDER BY applied_at, id

SELECT e.id, e.course_id, e.user_id, e.applied_by, e.application_type, e.status, e.applied_at, e.approved_at, e.rejected_at, e.cancelled_at, e.withdrawn_at, e.rejection_reason, e.cancellation_reason, e.created_at, e.updated_at, CASE WHEN e.status = 'WAITLISTED' THEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY e.course_id, e.status ORDER BY e.applied_at, e.id ) END AS waitlist_position, , COALESCE(pat.attended_count, 0) AS attended_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_course_sessions cs WHERE cs.course_id = e.course_id AND cs.status <> 'CANCELLED') AS session_count, pat.last_studied_at FROM tb_enrollments e
WHERE e.course_id = #{criteria.courseId} ORDER BY
e.updated_at e.applied_at e.status e.user_id e.created_at
ASC DESC , e.id ASC LIMIT #{criteria.limit} OFFSET #{criteria.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_enrollments WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 'APPROVED'
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_enrollments SET status = #{row.status}, approved_at = #{row.approvedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, rejected_at = #{row.rejectedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, cancelled_at = #{row.cancelledAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, withdrawn_at = #{row.withdrawnAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, rejection_reason = #{row.rejectionReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, cancellation_reason = #{row.cancellationReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = #{row.updatedAt} WHERE id = #{row.id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
